{{Quote|Sith blood's not everything. Lord Thrain dislikes my apprentice's privileged attitude.|Ardran|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''apprentice''' of [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Ardran]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Thrain]] viewed the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] as having a privileged attitude on account of his being a pureblood, and Thrain's disapproval meant that the apprentice would likely never become a full [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
